name: ninja
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game weapon/VFX SPRITE ATLAS, not a presentation. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, do not redraw its subject. Generate a NEW atlas matching the reference's detailed shaded pixel-art sci-fi dungeon rendering, dark outlines, dimensional metal, crisp highlights and emissive accents; NOT flat SVG icons, NOT flat minimal vector art. Ninja: ornate steel four-bladed shuriken with violet energy crystal, the projectile is a smaller matching shuriken. Launch crescent violet slash, thin violet blade trail pointing right, angular violet spark impact, small violet cut mark.
Composition: exactly 3 columns by 2 rows of equally sized cells, landscape canvas 1536x1024, no borders or gridlines. Reading order: top left HELD WEAPON; top middle PROJECTILE; top right LAUNCH effect; bottom left TRAIL; bottom middle IMPACT; bottom right TARGET residual effect. Each sprite is isolated at the center of its own cell with generous fully transparent padding, no elements crossing cell boundaries, no text, no labels, no UI cards, no scene, no ground shadows. All six sprites share consistent material, palette and polish, readable when reduced to 24–48 game pixels. No hands or characters. True transparent background across canvas and between sprites, preserve alpha; not painted checkerboard. Weapon silhouette clear and refined, restrained glow not broad fog.
